I contacted EMPET Ryen on Saturday because my cat had blood in her urine, and was told to take a urine sample on Sunday. When I submitted the sample on Monday, I was told that it could be too old and give misleading results. It was analyzed anyway, and I was billed for it.
When I asked what the result meant, I was told that it had to be paid for as a consultation. I also experienced pressure to do more tests. When I explained that I have poor finances, I experienced that the mood worsened, and I was told that I should have said so earlier.
I understand that veterinarians have to charge for their time. But I missed clear information in advance about what things cost and what I would actually get, and more understanding of my situation.

I was left with the feeling that finances outweighed the animal's best interests.

Thank you for finally clearing it up, It took a while but I'm happy that you cleared it up despite 4-5 emails. I hope it happens after you let me know and not that you have to post a bad review

When I buy Hils food you should get Hils's 20
% discount. The employees at the Ryen office never register this, they say send an email. There is no problem we can register back in time. Been annoyed by it but when I finally got an email sent I get a message that it doesn't work. I have bought special food for many years that they have said I must give and not other food due to the health of the cat. It is either cheating or laziness. I have stopped using them as a vet and instead go to the Nydalen subject and now I stop using them for food. It is actually a lot of money they have cheated me out of. I'm talking around 1200 kr discount a year for several years

Norway's most expensive vet, the vet here always hears "strange heart sounds" that no other vets hear, we were with 2 different dogs here, and the same on both, it costs 3000kr to get that message, then they recommend that you go to Empet Animal Hospital and spend another 15-20 thousand to check the sound they heard, here you can save a lot of money by going a little outside of Oslo and to a vet who takes 1/3 of the price and gives feedback that is useful and doesn't try to rob you when you come in the door

Stay far away! Incredibly dishonest people who milk you for money and also for the wrong diagnosis. We feel cheated and fooled. The vet was mostly interested in squeezing in as many Latin words as possible and imposing as many tests on the dog as possible that were completely unnecessary. She also spoke badly about the breed of our dog and her colleague who was sitting at the reception. When I complained to the general manager about our experience, she only agreed with the treatment we received and clearly thought this was a completely fair treatment of people and animals. These people should not be allowed to work with either people or animals.

We are incredibly grateful for the wonderful care we received for our beloved dog Molly at EMPET Ryen. From the moment we walked in the door, we were greeted with professionalism, care and expertise.

Molly was treated with great care by the dedicated team. Their knowledge and experience was evident in every interaction, and we felt safe and cared for throughout the process. Thank you to all the staff, especially the veterinarian who treated Molly with such care and understanding.

We cannot recommend Ryen Dyreklinikk enough to other pet owners. Their commitment to animal health and well-being is exceptional, and we are forever grateful for the care they showed Molly and us. Thank you so much!
